name: Discover it Chrome

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 15 months on purchases and balance transfers; 17.49% to 26.49% variable APR after that; Balance Transfer Fee applies.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fee (standard across Discover consumer cards).

base_rate.description: Earn unlimited 1% cash back on all other purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back won't expire for the life of the account. Cashback Match: unlimited dollar-for-dollar match of all cash back earned at end of first year, automatically. No limit to how much Discover will match.

signup_bonus.description: Unlimited Cashback Match: Discover automatically matches all the cash back earned from account approval through the first 365 days (effectively 2x first-year cash back); no limit to the match and no purchase minimums.

benefits.title: Unlimited Cashback Match
benefits.description: Get an unlimited dollar-for-dollar match of all the cash back you earn at the end of your first year, automatically. There is no limit to how much we'll match.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability
benefits.description: You're never responsible for unauthorized purchases on your Discover Card.

benefits.title: Free Social Security Number Alerts
benefits.description: Get an alert if we find your Social Security number on the dark web. Sign up to activate this free benefit.

benefits.title: Freeze Your Account
benefits.description: If you misplace your card, you can prevent new purchases and cash advances in seconds with the on/off switch on our mobile app and website.

benefits.title: FICO Score and More
benefits.description: It's free and checking your score doesn't hurt your credit.

benefits.title: Real Human Customer Service 24/7
benefits.description: You can talk to a real human on our customer service team any time.

benefits.title: Tap to Pay
benefits.description: It's fast and easy to pay with your contactless Discover Card.

notes: Discover it Chrome. Product name set from the official page H1 (the 'Gas & Restaurant Credit Card' string was the page subtitle). Confirmed actively open to new applicants (Apply Now / pre-approval on the official page). No annual fee. 2% cash back at gas stations and restaurants on up to $1,000 combined each quarter, 1% on all other purchases. 0% intro APR for 15 months, then 17.49%-26.49% variable. Cashback Match in first year. Image is the correct Chrome card art hosted on the Capital One CDN (Capital One now owns Discover).
